evals.expected_output: PeopleInSpace builds its iOS app (PeopleInSpaceSwiftUI) through Kotlin Swift Export: SKIE is gone, :common declares export { swift { moduleName = "common"; rootPackage = "dev.johnoreilly.common" } } instead of binaries.framework, a thin :ios-export umbrella module with api(project(":common")) and xcodeIntegration() is added, the Xcode Run Script calls :ios-export:embedSwiftExportForXcode, the deployment target is 18.0 and the Swift call sites use the Swift Export API.
